notes: Meetings were on Zoom in Sept 2026.
name: Mayor's Youth Advisory Council (MYAC)
what_you_do: Up to 21 high school students advise the Mayor's office on city issues from the youth point of view.
who_can_apply: You must be in high school now (freshman to senior). You speak for communities across the City. The page gives no minimum or maximum age. The City's Youth Connect list shows ages 14 and up.
duration: Meets quarterly (Sept, Dec, March, June), first Wednesday, 5:30 to 6:30 p.m.
deadline_text: Application dates not posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply to MYAC link on the City's Youth Connect page. The page gives no further steps.
